about_the_game:
A 2D real-time strategy game with base building, resource management, and chaotic slime battles!

In Slime Wars, take command in fast-paced RTS matches where you gather resources, build up your base, train a gooey army, and crush your enemies. Whether you're defending your own slime stronghold or launching an all-out assault, every decision counts.

Build smarter. Attack harder. Emerge victorious.

🛠️ Core Gameplay

  • Harvest resources to expand your economy

  • Build and upgrade your base with strategic structures

  • Train unique slime units, each with their own strengths

  • Attack enemy bases while defending your own

  • Adapt your strategy in real-time against enemy tactics

⚔️ Key Features

  • Classic RTS gameplay with a 2D twist

  • Base-building, tech progression, and unit production

  • Multiple unit types and abilities to master

  • A charming, chaotic world full of gooey warfare

  • Solo and (future) multiplayer modes planned

Whether you're a seasoned RTS veteran or new to the genre, Slime Wars offers a tight, tactical experience wrapped in a colorful, chaotic world of slime.

Checkout the Patreon to support our development!
